title: Linear scheme stability and Lax equivalence

items.title: Common Banach-space interface for a linear IVP and its time schemes
items.statement: On one Banach space X, fix a strongly continuous solution semigroup U(t) with finite-time operator bounds, a dense invariant consistency subspace D, and bounded common-space steps S_nu; define local consistency, finite-time power stability, and locally uniform-in-grid-time convergence in the same X norm.

references.title: Lloyd N. Trefethen, Finite Difference and Spectral Methods, Chapter 4, §4.2
R. J. LeVeque, AMath 585–6 Notes, Chapter 12, §§12.1–12.5.1

items.title: The diagonal heat semigroup on $c_0$ is contractive and strongly continuous
items.statement: On real or complex c0 with the supremum norm, U(t)(x_j)=(exp(-j^2 t)x_j) is a strongly continuous semigroup and ||U(t)||_op <= 1 for every t >= 0.

references.title: Lloyd N. Trefethen, Finite Difference and Spectral Methods, Chapter 4, §4.2
R. J. LeVeque, AMath 585–6 Notes, Chapter 12, §§12.1–12.5.1

items.title: Finite-grid restriction, reconstruction, and common-space lift
items.statement: For finite-dimensional grid spaces G_nu with bounded restriction P_nu, reconstruction R_nu and grid update Q_nu, require P_nu R_nu=I and U(tau_nu) ker(P_nu) subset ker(P_nu); define the common-space lift S_nu=R_nu Q_nu P_nu + U(tau_nu)(I-R_nu P_nu).

references.title: Lloyd N. Trefethen, Finite Difference and Spectral Methods, Chapter 4, §4.2
R. J. LeVeque, AMath 585–6 Notes, Chapter 12, §§12.1–12.5.1

items.title: Lax equivalence for a common Banach-space scheme
items.statement: Under DC, a consistent common-space bounded linear scheme for a well-posed autonomous linear IVP on one Banach space is locally uniformly convergent on each finite time interval if and only if its powers are uniformly bounded there in the same norm.

references.title: Lloyd N. Trefethen, Finite Difference and Spectral Methods, Chapter 4, §4.2
R. J. LeVeque, AMath 585–6 Notes, Chapter 12, §§12.1–12.5.1

items.title: Grid and common-space stability agree under uniform norm comparison
items.statement: For a finite-grid common-space lift, if reconstruction and restriction norms and the grid-to-reconstruction norm comparison constants are uniformly bounded, uniform finite-time power stability in grid norms is equivalent to uniform finite-time power stability of the lifted common-space steps.

references.title: Lloyd N. Trefethen, Finite Difference and Spectral Methods, Chapter 4, §4.2
R. J. LeVeque, AMath 585–6 Notes, Chapter 12, §§12.1–12.5.1

title: Linear scheme stability and Lax equivalence — Examples

items.title: A stable consistent explicit spectral-grid heat step
items.statement: For the diagonal heat semigroup on c0, the finite spectral grid with tau_m=m^-2 and forward Euler multipliers 1-tau_m j^2 is contractive, consistent on finite-support sequences, and converges in the common norm under DC.

references.title: Lloyd N. Trefethen, Finite Difference and Spectral Methods, Chapter 4, §4.2
R. J. LeVeque, AMath 585–6 Notes, Chapter 12, §§12.1–12.5.1

items.title: A consistent but unstable explicit spectral-grid heat step
items.statement: For the same diagonal heat semigroup, the spectral-grid forward Euler step with tau_m=m^-1 is consistent on finite-support sequences but unstable because its highest included mode has multiplier 1-(m-1)^2/m with unbounded magnitude.

references.title: Lloyd N. Trefethen, Finite Difference and Spectral Methods, Chapter 4, §4.2
R. J. LeVeque, AMath 585–6 Notes, Chapter 12, §§12.1–12.5.1

items.title: A mesh-dependent grid norm hides common-space instability
items.statement: On c0, finite-grid updates can be power-stable in mesh-dependent norms while their common-space lifts are unstable when reconstruction/restriction norm comparisons are not uniform.

references.title: Lloyd N. Trefethen, Finite Difference and Spectral Methods, Chapter 4, §4.2
R. J. LeVeque, AMath 585–6 Notes, Chapter 12, §§12.1–12.5.1
